 Stroke of luck? Bayern Munich star Michael Olise could potentially return Monday
 FC Bayern might have just dodged a major bullet.
 by CSmith1919 Nov 20, 2026, 10:24 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 (Photo by Adam Pretty/Getty Images) Getty Images Part Of Bayern Munich vs. FC Köln: 2026/27 Bundesliga full coverage see all updates CSmith1919 Chuck Smith is the site manager for Bavarian Football Works, where he began writing in 2017. He is the author of The Daily Schmankerl, the longest-running daily Bayern Munich column in English, and also writes The Weekend Warm-Up. In addition to covering Bayern Munich news and providing commentary on Bayern Munich, the Bundesliga, and the German national team. He brings more than 30 years of sports-writing experience to the site. Over the course of his career, he has written for numerous newspapers and websites. here is some optimism surrounding Michael Olise after the winger was forced off at halftime during Bayern Munich’s 1–1 draw with Köln. The initial hope is that the injury will not keep him out for an extended period, although the club is still waiting for clarity.
 As captured by @iMiaSanMia , Vincent Kompany offered an encouraging update, saying there is hope Olise will be back in training on Monday. The Bayern Munich coach also suggested that the problem should not be anything serious—welcome news for a squad already dealing with several injury concerns.
 Sporting director Max Eberl, however, was considerably more cautious when asked about the situation. His assessment was brief, making clear that Bayern Munich does not yet have a definitive diagnosis.
 “We don’t know yet,” Eberl said, as reported by Abendzeitung’s Maximilian Koch (via @iMiaSanMia ).
 For now, Kompany’s optimism offers some reason for encouragement, though Olise’s availability will depend on the results of further examinations and how he responds over the coming days.
